001package pkg_ItemPack;
002
003/**
004 * Item class
005 */
006public class Item
007{
008    private String aName;
009    private String aDescription;
010    private int aWeight;
011    private int aValue;
012
013    /**
014     * Constructeur d'objets de classe Item
015     */
016    public Item(final String pName, final String pDescription, final int pWeight, final int pValue)
017    {
018        this.aName        = pName;
019        this.aDescription = pDescription;
020        this.aWeight      = pWeight;
021        this.aValue       = pValue;
022    }
023    
024    public String getName()
025    {
026        return this.aName;
027    }
028    
029    public String getDescription()
030    {
031        return this.aDescription;
032    }
033    
034    public int getWeight()
035    {
036        return this.aWeight;
037    }
038    
039    public int getValue()
040    {
041        return this.aValue;
042    }
043    
044    public String getLongDescription()
045    {
046        return this.aDescription + ", wheight : " + this.aWeight;
047    }
048}
